articles.title: Meerut: ACM Office Peon Caught Red-Handed Taking ₹5,000 Bribe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Meerut, the Anti-Corruption Team on Monday raided the ACM Fourth Office and arrested peon Ranveer while accepting a bribe of ₹5,000. Officials said Ranveer had allegedly demanded money from a complainant, Santarpal, for office-related work.

body.html:

Acting on the complaint, the team laid a trap and caught him red-handed. The accused has been taken to Civil Lines police station for questioning.

articles.title: Constable Catches Constable Wife With Lover, Locks Him In Room
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident unfolded in Kushinagar’s Shaheed Major Amiy Tripathi Nagar, where a police constable caught his constable wife with her alleged lover inside their rented house.

body.html:
A dramatic incident unfolded in Kushinagar’s Shaheed Major Amiy Tripathi Nagar, where a police constable caught his constable wife with her alleged lover inside their rented house.

On Sunday morning, Mithilesh Yadav, a constable posted in Kushinagar, returned home unexpectedly and found his wife, Simpi Yadav, also a constable, inside a room with another policeman, identified as Constable Vishwanath Rai.

According to Mithilesh, his wife refused to open the door after locking her lover inside. He broke the lock with a frying pan and kicked the door open. As soon as Vishwanath came out, locals caught and thrashed him before police took him to the station.

Mithilesh alleged that his wife had been in an affair for some time and used to call her lover home whenever he went on duty. He stated that he would not continue to live with her, claiming she could harm him with her lover.

Police confirmed that the matter is under investigation.

articles.title: Mansa Tragedy: Brick Kiln Wall Collapses, Elderly Farmer Crushed to Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An elderly man lost his life in Punjab’s Mansa district after a brick kiln godown wall collapsed in Jawaharke village due to rain. The victim, identified as Jagjivan Singh, was passing on his bicycle when the wall suddenly fell, burying him. CCTV footage captured the incident.

body.html:
An elderly man lost his life in Punjab’s Mansa district after a brick kiln godown wall collapsed in Jawaharke village due to rain. The victim, identified as Jagjivan Singh, was passing on his bicycle when the wall suddenly fell, burying him.

CCTV footage captured the incident. Locals rushed him to the hospital, but doctors declared him dead on arrival. Villagers alleged that despite repeated warnings about the weak condition of the wall, the brick kiln owner ignored the issue.

Police confirmed that an investigation has been launched, and CCTV footage is being examined.
